facts.business: Modern Steels Limited is a manufacturing company of steel products that has sold its manufacturing business and is working out its future course of business.
facts.related_party_note: All contracts or arrangements entered into by the Company with Related Parties have been done at arm's length and are in the ordinary course of business. Related Party disclosures as per IND AS-24 have been provided in the Notes to the Financial Statements. Further, no material related party transactions held during the financial year 2025-26. Hence, Form AOC-2 is not applicable.
